blocks.text: Moira Dela Torre held a press conference announcing her fourth major headline concert, ‘Where It All Started,’ set to take over the SM Mall of Asia Arena this October 4, 2026. Ovation Productions and QX Live mounted the show, which marked a milestone for the OPM powerhouse, who became the first local female solo act to surpass 11 million Spotify followers and continued to hold her title as one of the most-streamed Filipina artists of her generation.
